resolution: Raised the shared hmsc-int/game physics rect cap from 2048 to 4096 on both sides of the bridge: cart/hmsc-int/game/physics.ts now exports PHYSICS_LIMITS.rects=4096 and framework/game/physics.zig now accepts MAX_RECTS=4096. Verified the native physics unit suite, the full tools/rjit game verify run, a fresh SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 tools/rjit ship hmsc-int rebuild, and fresh headless shots for /test and /compiled. This fixes the PlayRoute configureCameraOcclusion crash caused by the current map producing 2074 camera occlusion rects while preserving boundary rejection for counts above the raised host cap.
